text: Returns the dual-level fusion weight from the given weights mapping as a float, yielding 0.0 when the "dual_level_enabled" flag is falsy and otherwise the value of "w_dual". No side effects.

Fetches up to `limit` workstreams for a given `project` (optionally filtered by `state` of "open" or "closed"), ordered newest-first and keyset-paginated via an opaque `before` cursor, returning a dict of serialized items plus a `next_before` cursor for the following page (or None when exhausted). It performs a read-only database query and raises ValueError for an invalid state value.

Converts a Workstream object into a dictionary of its fields, with the ID stringified, timestamps rendered as ISO 8601 strings (or None for a missing closed_at), and properties defaulting to an empty dict. It is a pure read with no side effects.

Validates that a `reasoning_effort` value is accepted by the vendor identified by `api_kind`, raising a `RuntimeError` with the vendor's supported values if the parameter is unsupported, retired, or outside the allowed set; returns `None` otherwise and has no side effects.
Returns True if the given relation type string belongs to the REPLACES family (REPLACES, IMPROVES_ON, or legacy BUILDS_ON), and False otherwise, including when the input is None.

Updates the workstream identified by `workstream_id` with any of the provided `state`, `retain`, `title`, or merged `properties` values, persisting the changes to the database and returning the refreshed `Workstream`. It raises `ValueError` for an invalid state, `WorkstreamNotFound` if the record is missing, or `WorklogRejected` on an integrity violation, and records a close/reopen event journal entry when the state transitions.
Given a base URL string, returns the URL with a trailing `/v1` or `/api` suffix removed (and any trailing slashes stripped), otherwise returns it unchanged; no side effects.

Validates an operator-supplied mapping of model names to rate dictionaries, returning a cleaned `dict[str, dict[str, int]]` with rates coerced to non-negative integers, or raising `ValueError` if any entry is malformed, contains unknown rate fields, or has negative or non-numeric values.
Fetches the workstream matching the given UUID from the database, optionally acquiring a row-level lock when `for_update` is true, and returns it or `None` if no match exists.

Given an async database session and a sequence of memory IDs, this clears the `superseded_by` pointer on all memories referencing those IDs and sets their status to 'deprecated', performing a single bulk UPDATE within the caller's transaction. It returns nothing and must be invoked before any deletion of the referenced memories to avoid constraint violations.

Fetches up to `limit` worklog entries for a given `workstream_id`, optionally filtered by `kind`, a `since` timestamp, and a `seq` cursor (`after`), returning a dict with serialized entries and a `next_after` cursor for pagination. Raises `ValueError` for an invalid `kind`; performs a read-only database query with no mutations.
Converts a WorklogEntry object into a dictionary with string-serialized IDs, ISO-formatted timestamp, and defaulted properties. Returns the dictionary representation; no side effects.

Given per-arm signal values and weight configuration, returns the product of the individual arm multipliers as a single float representing the composed post-fusion scaling factor (where zero-weight arms contribute exactly 1.0). It has no side effects.
Raises a RuntimeError if the vendor identified by `api_kind` (with `model` named in the error) lacks an embeddings endpoint, otherwise returns None. Has no side effects beyond the exception.
